answer: Because the vault count is verified against the dune text itself, the willow audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. Filling 91 aliases hence means producing 91 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 6 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. That is 6 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
